Effect of Long-Term Exposure to dDAVP on Transcript Abundances in Mouse mpkCCD Cells (RNA-seq)

This database shows RNA-seq data from cultured mouse collecting duct cells (mpkCCD) documenting responses to the V2 receptor-selective vasopressin analog dDAVP at a concentration of 0.1 nM for 48 hours (dDAVP, n=5 vs. Vehicle, n=5). P values based on t-statistic were generated for stratification of results. Among the transcripts with P less than 0.01, positive log2(dDAVP/vehicle) values are indicated in green, while those with negative values are indicated in red.

Database was created by Euijung Park, Lihe Chen, and Mark Knepper in the Epithelial Systems Biology Laboratory (Mark Knepper, Chief) at the National Heart, Lung and Blood Institute as part of its Kidney Systems Biology Project. Reference: Pending. Click to download processed data as spreadsheet.
